question: Study all genes expressed in salivary gland according to HPA consensus RNA data. Report the cohort size, counts by RNA tissue specificity category, the number of FDA approved drug targets and counts measured by blood immunoassay, by mass spectrometry, by both and by neither. Among cohort genes secreted to blood, rank twelve by log2((salivary gland nTPM+1)/(liver nTPM+1)), ties by Ensembl ID. Give their consensus nTPM in salivary gland, liver, pancreas and kidney, their specificity categories and the available blood concentrations. Draw a specificity-category bar chart, a blood-assay-coverage chart and the four-tissue heatmap; provide the tables. If a requested ranked list has fewer eligible members, return every eligible member and state the count. Use Ensembl genes present in the HPA master table as the gene universe and break all gene-ranking ties by Ensembl ID.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT Tissue, COUNT(*) n FROM rna_tissue_consensus GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"RNA tissue specificity\" cat, COUNT(*) n FROM proteinatlas GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"Protein class\", COUNT(*) n FROM proteinatlas WHERE lower(\"Protein class\") LIKE '%drug%' GROUP BY 1"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"Secretome location\", COUNT(*) n FROM proteinatlas GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 20"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH c AS (SELECT p.Ensembl id,p.Gene,p.\"RNA tissue specificity\" spec,p.\"Protein class\" pc,p.\"Blood concentration - Conc. blood IM [pg/L]\" im,p.\"Blood concentration - Conc. blood MS [pg/L]\" ms,s.nTPM sal FROM proteinatlas p JOIN rna_tissue_consensus s ON p.Ensembl=s.Gene WHERE s.Tissue='salivary gland' AND TRY_CAST(s.nTPM AS DOUBLE)>0), a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) cohort, SUM(CASE WHEN spec='Tissue enriched' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) tissue_enriched,SUM(CASE WHEN spec='Tissue enhanced' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) tissue_enhanced,SUM(CASE WHEN spec='Group enriched' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) group_enriched,SUM(CASE WHEN spec='Low tissue specificity' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) low_spec,SUM(CASE WHEN spec='Not detected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) not_detected,SUM(CASE WHEN pc LIKE '%FDA approved drug targets%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) fda,SUM(CASE WHEN NULLIF(im,'') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) im_n,SUM(CASE WHEN NULLIF(ms,'') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ms_n FROM c) SELECT * FROM a; SELECT spec,COUNT(*) n FROM c GROUP BY spec ORDER BY spec;" }

tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH x AS (SELECT p.Ensembl id,p.Gene,p.\"RNA tissue specificity\" spec,p.\"Blood concentration - Conc. blood IM [pg/L]\" im,p.\"Blood concentration - Conc. blood MS [pg/L]\" ms,p.\"Secretome location\" sec,MAX(CASE WHEN r.Tissue='salivary gland' THEN TRY_CAST(r.nTPM AS DOUBLE) END) sal,MAX(CASE WHEN r.Tissue='liver' THEN TRY_CAST(r.nTPM AS DOUBLE) END) liver,MAX(CASE WHEN r.Tissue='pancreas' THEN TRY_CAST(r.nTPM AS DOUBLE) END) pancreas,MAX(CASE WHEN r.Tissue='kidney' THEN TRY_CAST(r.nTPM AS DOUBLE) END) kidney FROM proteinatlas p JOIN rna_tissue_consensus r ON p.Ensembl=r.Gene WHERE p.Ensembl IN (SELECT p2.Ensembl FROM proteinatlas p2 JOIN rna_tissue_consensus r2 ON p2.Ensembl=r2.Gene WHERE r2.Tissue='salivary gland' AND TRY_CAST(r2.nTPM AS DOUBLE)>0) GROUP BY ALL) SELECT id,Gene,ROUND(LOG2((sal+1)/(liver+1)),6) rank_score,sal,liver,pancreas,kidney,spec,im,ms FROM x WHERE sec='Secreted to blood' ORDER BY rank_score DESC,id LIMIT 12"}
